CASE 01 // VERIFIED RECORD

Garaa

Identity & document verification

Problem

Manual KYC and identity checks break down when documents suffer blur, glare, tampered text, or mismatched faces.

Idea

Unify OCR extraction, QR decoding, face detection, and image-quality verification into a single deterministic verdict.

My Role

Built and shipped with Team Garaa — 1st Runner-up at Baloon National Hackathon 2026.

Implementation

Browser-native verification pipeline combining OCR, QR parsing, face landmark checks, and document quality scoring.
